# HolidayMonk

> > HolidayMonk is a travel company specializing in curated tour packages and travel guides across India, Morocco, Sri Lanka, and international destinations with focus on luxury, pilgrimage, and sustainable tourism.

HolidayMonk offers comprehensive travel planning services including luxury holidays, cultural tours, pilgrimage packages, and destination guides. The site features detailed itineraries for destinations across India (Karnataka, Uttar Pradesh, Goa, Kerala), international locations (Morocco, Sri Lanka, Vietnam, Taiwan), and specialized experiences like cruise travel, beach tourism, and sustainable ecotourism.

- India tour packages
